// Adds a Nikon ncdt list, as Nikon compact cameras write one, to an AVI
// made by ffmpeg: an ncvr record, an nctg record of tags (make, model,
// software, orientation, exposure time, the dates), a thumbnail JPEG
// (ncth) and an empty preview (ncvw). It takes the start of ffmpeg's JUNK
// padding chunk, which stays after it, shorter: nothing moves, so the
// index's absolute offsets stay right.
//
// Usage: go run ncdt.go <in.avi> <thumbnail.jpg> <out.avi>
package main

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"os"
)

func le16(b []byte, v uint16) []byte { return binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint16(b, v) }
func le32(b []byte, v uint32) []byte { return binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32(b, v) }

// chunk is a RIFF chunk. Odd data gets a zero byte counted in its size,
// as the camera's chunks are all even: readers that skip a chunk by its
// size, without RIFF's pad byte, stay in step.
func chunk(id string, data []byte) []byte {
	if len(data)%2 == 1 {
		data = append(data[:len(data):len(data)], 0)
	}
	return append(le32([]byte(id), uint32(len(data))), data...)
}

// tag is an ncvr or nctg record: tag, size, value.
func tag(t uint16, v []byte) []byte { return append(le16(le16(nil, t), uint16(len(v))), v...) }

func str(s string, n int) []byte { b := make([]byte, n); copy(b, s); return b }

func main() {
	in, _ := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	thumb, _ := os.ReadFile(os.Args[2])
	var ncvr, nctg []byte
	ncvr = append(ncvr, tag(0x01, str("NIKON", 6))...)
	ncvr = append(ncvr, tag(0x02, []byte{0, 0, 1, 0})...)
	nctg = append(nctg, tag(0x03, str("NIKON", 6))...)
	nctg = append(nctg, tag(0x04, str("COOLPIX S1", 12))...)
	nctg = append(nctg, tag(0x05, str("COOLPIX S1V1.0", 16))...)
	nctg = append(nctg, tag(0x07, le16(nil, 1))...)
	nctg = append(nctg, tag(0x08, le32(le32(nil, 1), 60))...)
	nctg = append(nctg, tag(0x0d, le16(nil, 0))...)
	nctg = append(nctg, tag(0x13, str("2013:05:06 07:08:09", 20))...)
	nctg = append(nctg, tag(0x14, str("2013:05:06 07:08:09", 20))...)
	// The records fill their chunks exactly, as the camera's do: a pad
	// byte there would read as the start of another record.
	if len(ncvr)%2 == 1 || len(nctg)%2 == 1 {
		panic("records of odd length")
	}
	body := []byte("ncdt")
	body = append(body, chunk("ncvr", ncvr)...)
	body = append(body, chunk("nctg", nctg)...)
	body = append(body, chunk("ncth", thumb)...)
	body = append(body, chunk("ncvw", nil)...)
	list := chunk("LIST", body)
	// The top-level JUNK chunk (hdrl has one of its own).
	at := 12
	for at+8 <= len(in) && string(in[at:at+4]) != "JUNK" {
		m := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(in[at+4:]))
		at += 8 + m + m&1
	}
	if at+8 > len(in) {
		panic("no top-level JUNK chunk")
	}
	n := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(in[at+4:]))
	rest := n - len(list) // the JUNK left: 8 + rest bytes
	if rest < 0 || rest%2 == 1 {
		panic("the ncdt list doesn't fit the JUNK chunk")
	}
	out := append([]byte(nil), in[:at]...)
	out = append(out, list...)
	out = append(out, chunk("JUNK", make([]byte, rest))...)
	out = append(out, in[at+8+n:]...)
	if len(out) != len(in) {
		panic("the file changed size")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[3], out, 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
